source: NASA Mars Trek (NASA/JPL Solar System Treks), ArcGIS image service for the Mars Trek DEM layer
catalogTitle: MGS MOLA and Mars Express HRSC, DEM
product: MGS MOLA and Mars Express HRSC, DEM (blended, 200 m/pixel)
encodes: Elevation in meters (the service stores signed 16-bit meters; we asked for 32-bit floats and rounded to whole meters). These are real heights, not shaded-relief colors.

center.name: Arcadia Planitia (center of the plain, IAU/USGS Gazetteer)

order: row-major; row 0 = northern edge, column 0 = western edge; values at pixel centers; the middle sample is the base site
notes: A 119 x 81 grid, 3 km apart north-south and 2.059 km east-west (about 240 km across), resampled from the 200 m DEM by the Mars Trek image server (bilinear). Degrees were converted to km on the Mars 2000 sphere (radius 3,396.19 km) with a flat (equirectangular) approximation around the base site. Bounds use the image server's -180..180 east longitudes (192 E = -168). The game uses only height differences from the base site. In the diorama the landscape is shrunk to 1 scene unit per km (the base itself is not to scale), heights are exaggerated (see src/render/arcadia.ts), and the ground right around the base is flattened for the buildings.
